comment: Adults use MAM-only app protection (see android-app-protection-baseline.json), which does not
require device enrollment or compliance (deviceComplianceRequired: false there). Without this
restriction, Company Portal offers to set up an Android Enterprise Work Profile the moment an
adult signs in to check on a stuck app - creating an unwanted managed container on a personal
phone. platformBlocked blocks Android Enterprise enrollment entirely for the adult tier; MAM app
protection for Outlook/OneDrive/Office/Edge/Teams is unaffected since it never enrolls the device.
name: adult-enrollment-restriction-android-for-work

payload.displayName: CaC - Enrollment - Adult Personal Devices (Android for Work)
payload.description: Managed by sf-intune-cac. Do not edit in the portal.
